It was nearly dawn, and Jiu Xing still wasn't at the next base camp, Zhongtu, although she could see it in the distance. She looked behind her to see how far up the sun was, when she spotted a grey figure in the sky. Assuming it was a cloud, she continued on, but was curious about it.

Minutes later Jiu was just outside the limits of the camp, when she heard a whirling sound, that of a machine, just behind her. She turned to see that the grey figure from earlier was right behind her, and was gaining up slowly. It's tentacles launched forward, grabbing her by the arm, hoisting her off of Stone. Just ahead of her she could see a small forest in front of the camp.

"Go on to the forest, Stone! I'll be right there!" She yelled from the grasp of the Sentinel.

Jiu tugged and tugged, pulling the Sentinel closer to the ground. Quickly the forest was approaching. Jiu reached her hand out to the bark of a tree, and vanished.

On the grass below, Jiu stepped out of the tree, unscathed. Above her she looked to see the Sentinel recalculate its course downwards, landing straight into a trunk. Stone lept out from behind some bushes, and started tearing it apart. When it was clear that it had stopped moving, Stone got off of it.

Jiu looked inside to see complicated parts of various shapes and sizes, which could be useful for many things. For now she threw the corpse into the wagon, mounted Stone, and continued onto Zhongtu.

When they arrived, Jiu headed to the local mechanic, to see if they could do anything with the parts. Ji Zao told her that he could do multiple things with the parts, most interesting being the creation of wings. Jiu accepted, and he built her[ wings out of the Sentinel's parts](http://basicks.eu/shop/img/p/3/0/6/306-thickbox_default.jpg). When they were finished, Ji noticed that he had parts left over, and asked if Jiu wanted anything else upgraded. She put out her bow, and within a few minutes, she had a [brand new bow](http://41.media.tumblr.com/c99d05418e56b3483802463d38081e3a/tumblr_mrtd39e3pr1s012pko3_1280.jpg), capable of firing multiple arrows at once.

That night, the could see the soldiers were prepared to fight the Flora tomorrow. This was Jiu's chance to finally have peace between the two species. But for now, she would sleep, getting up early for tomorrow.
